name: Line Chart
description: Shows trends over time with connected data points
data_requirements: at least 2 data series with time or category labels

name: Bar Chart
description: Compares values across categories with vertical or horizontal bars

name: Doughnut Chart
description: Shows proportions as a ring with optional center content

name: Area Chart
description: Filled line chart showing volume over time
data_requirements: at least 2 data series with time labels

name: Scatter Plot
description: Shows correlation between two variables with positioned dots

name: Radar Chart
description: Compares multiple variables on radial axes

name: Horizontal Bar
description: Bar chart with horizontal orientation for long labels

name: Stacked Bar
description: Stacked segments showing composition within categories
best_for: Part of whole across categories, composition trends

name: Mixed Chart
description: Combines line and bar charts for dual-axis visualization
best_for: Comparing different data types, dual metrics
data_requirements: multiple data series with different scales

name: Heatmap
description: Color-intensity grid showing values across two dimensions

name: Funnel Chart
description: Shows progressive reduction through stages
best_for: Conversion funnels, sales pipelines, user journeys

name: Gauge Chart
description: Shows a single value within a range like a speedometer
best_for: KPI display, progress toward goal, status indicator
data_requirements: single numeric value with min and max

name: Treemap
description: Nested rectangles showing hierarchical data proportions
best_for: Portfolio allocation, category breakdown, file systems

name: Bubble Chart
description: Scatter plot with variable-sized circles for third dimension
data_requirements: x y and size data points

name: Candlestick
description: Shows open high low close for financial data
best_for: Stock prices, financial analysis, trading data

name: Waterfall Chart
description: Shows cumulative effect of sequential positive and negative values

name: Sankey Diagram
description: Shows flow and transfer between nodes with varying widths
best_for: Resource allocation, user flow, energy distribution
data_requirements: flow data with source target and value

name: Network Graph
description: Shows connections and relationships between nodes

name: Pie Chart
description: Shows proportions as slices of a circle

name: Polar Area Chart
description: Shows proportions on radial axes with equal angles
data_requirements: single data series with radial axes

name: Bullet Chart
description: Compares a measure to a target with performance bands
best_for: Performance tracking, KPI vs target, goal progress

name: Sparkline
description: Minimal inline charts showing trends without axes
best_for: Inline trends, dashboard widgets, summary views

name: Histogram
description: Shows frequency distribution of continuous data

name: Box Plot
description: Shows data distribution through quartiles and outliers

name: Chord Diagram
description: Shows inter-relationships between entities in a circular layout
best_for: Flow analysis, relationship mapping, trade data
data_requirements: matrix of flow or relationship values
